description: A reusable, named bundle of effect Actions a Step node runs against workflow state and the subject. Declares its read/write contract on state (reads/writes) so a workflow can be checked for a missing producer at author time.

fields.label: Group Name
fields.description: Names the reusable action bundle so multiple workflows may reference it.

fields.label: Reads
fields.description: Declares the state keys the group reads (comma-separated), so a workflow can be checked for a missing producer at author time.

fields.label: Writes
fields.description: Declares the state keys the group writes (comma-separated).

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: The effect actions this group runs, in order, when a Step node references it.

name: CRM Action Group
